output.summary: KEP-4402 proposes adopting Go workspaces (a checked-in go.work file) in k/k to remove reliance on GOPATH for builds, verify/update scripts, and code generators, sequenced across k/k, gengo (moved to gengo/v2), and kube-openapi. Status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale:
The k/k repo's build and tooling depend on GOPATH hacks layered on top of Go modules and staging repos, which the KEP calls a constant source of complexity and friction. Go workspaces were created for this multi-module setup, so the KEP proposes adopting them and retooling gengo, kube-openapi, and the k/k scripts. The sources do not say more about the reasons beyond this, and the status history shows the work reached implemented from 2024-03-01.</rationale>
